character: A large south-central Vermont resort above the town of Ludlow, operated by Vail Resorts, with two main base areas (the original base and Jackson Gore) and a reputation for groomed, family-friendly skiing.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the base areas. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No confirmed 2026-27 opening date on file as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Nov 20, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Vail Resorts released its 2026/27 opening dates on Aug 18, 2026, but the search summary did not show Okemo's date — check the release (More links). For reference, Okemo, Stowe and Mount Snow targeted Sat Nov 22, 2025 for 2025-26 (announced Oct 29, 2025) — a target, not a confirmed opening day.
